questions.stem: Why is the recycling of nutrients through decomposition essential for ecosystems?

options.text: It produces oxygen for animals to breathe
It prevents any organisms from dying
It returns minerals and nutrients to the soil so they can be taken up by plants again
It creates new species of decomposers

questions.explanation: Decomposition breaks down dead organisms and waste products, returning essential minerals and nutrients to the soil. Plants can then absorb these nutrients through their roots, and the nutrients pass through the food chain again. Without decomposition, nutrients would remain locked in dead matter.
